title: Public chrome uses MyAPES Core consistently
summary: Guest-visible platform chrome now says MyAPES Core in the document title, PWA name, social tags, footer, and logo text. Login and registration pages may still say MyAPES Account.
changes: Keep PWA, Open Graph, Twitter, footer, and logo alt branding as MyAPES Core on public pages.
Keep login, register, password reset, and email verification titles as MyAPES Account.
version_rationale: Patch release: finishes leftover Core vs Account naming on public chrome without changing sign-in, roles, or routes.
validation: PHPUnit PublicChromeNamingTest covers Core titles and chrome on guest platform pages, Account titles on login and register surfaces, PWA manifest names, onboarding, and email verification.
PHPUnit HealthAndThemeTest, BrandedErrorPagesTest, and PublicLegalPagesTest cover related public chrome.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
known_limitations: The GitHub repository name and other internal identifiers stay MyAPES-Account.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version to restore the earlier mix of Core and Account names on public chrome.
provenance: Core vs Account public chrome naming for issue #125, pull request #206.
